INSERT INTO consortia
consortia_name,
consortia_img,
consortia_no,
consortia_content,
user_id,
create_time
#{consortiaName},
#{consortiaImg},
#{consortiaNo},
#{consortiaContent},
#{userId},
#{createTime}
mapper.select:
select c.*,u.user_name as userName,u.phone, (select ifnull(sum(money),0) from user_money_details s where s.user_id=c.user_id and classify in (5,6)) as sunMoney, (select ifnull(sum(money),0) from user_money_details s where s.user_id=c.user_id and classify=5) as ordersMoney, (select ifnull(sum(money),0) from user_money_details s where s.user_id=c.user_id and classify=6) as giftMoney, (select count(*) from tb_user s where s.consortia_id=c.consortia_id) as counts from consortia c left join tb_user u on u.user_id=c.user_id where 1=1
and c.consortia_name like concat('%',#{consortiaName},'%')
and u.user_name like concat('%',#{userName},'%')
and u.phone=#{phone}
order by c.create_time desc
